milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find a sheep' is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near one of the sheep (at spawn-relative coords ~-7,0,7 or ~-8,0,8) and face it, modeling 'the player can see the sheep.' Target is set to (-7, 0, 7) — the closer sheep. max_distance=5 ensures the player must walk from spawn (~10 blocks away) to within 5 blocks of the sheep. facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is actually looking at the sheep, not just passing nearby.

Uses inventory_has because selling leather to the leatherworker villager results in an emerald appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with only a diamond sword (no emeralds), so having ≥1 emerald proves a successful trade was completed. This is the concrete outcome of the sell action — the villager's trade gives 1 emerald for 1 leather.
